mapper.select: -- 원문/source 결합과 봉인된 최신 시도만 읽는다. 제목 제외 및 QA 목적 원문은 운영 분석 API에 노출하지 않는다. SELECT x.source_id,x.set_id,x.file_id,x.id AS extraction_id,x.quality_code,x.extracted_text, x.blocks_json::text AS blocks_json,x.page_count,f.document_role_code,f.role_origin_code FROM announcement_source_attachment_extractions x JOIN announcement_source_attachment_files f ON f.id=x.file_id AND f.set_id=x.set_id AND f.source_id=x.source_id JOIN announcement_source_attachment_sets aset ON aset.id=x.set_id AND aset.source_id=x.source_id AND aset.set_status_code='SEALED' JOIN announcement_source_snapshots s ON s.id=x.source_id AND s.data_purpose_code='PRODUCTION' JOIN announcement_source_classification_evaluations b ON b.source_id=s.id AND b.is_current AND b.title_stage_code IN ('COMBINATION_MATCHED','GROUP_A_MATCHED') AND b.decision_status_code<>'EXCLUDED' WHERE x.source_id=#{sourceId} AND x.id=#{extractionId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_attachment_extractions newer WHERE newer.file_id=x.file_id AND newer.attempt_no>x.attempt_no)

-- 현재 분석기 버전의 저장 이력만 조회한다. GET은 분석을 생성하지 않는다. SELECT id,source_id,set_id,file_id,extraction_id,analysis_json::text AS analysis_json,created_at FROM announcement_attachment_segment_analyses WHERE source_id=#{sourceId} AND extraction_id=#{extractionId} AND analysis_version=#{analysisVersion} AND rules_hash=#{rulesHash}
mapper.insert: -- 동일 추출/버전 재요청은 불변 결과를 재사용한다. 기존 evaluation/role/current pointer는 수정하지 않는다. INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_segment_analyses (id,source_id,set_id,file_id,extraction_id,analysis_version,rules_hash,text_hash,blocks_hash,analysis_json) VALUES (#{id},#{sourceId},#{setId},#{fileId},#{extractionId},#{analysisVersion},#{rulesHash},#{textHash},#{blocksHash},CAST(#{analysisJson} AS jsonb)) ON CONFLICT (extraction_id,analysis_version,rules_hash) DO NOTHING
